name: ticket-swarm-workflow
description: Repo-local workflow plugin for design contracts, implementation-contract signoff, iterative development/testing composition, execution days, and feature-decision hygiene.

interface.longDescription: Repo-local workflow plugin for moving Squad work from design contracts into signed-off implementation contracts, then into iterative multi-agent development/testing composition with review loops, layered verification, receipts, and separate human-triggered release handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use $design-contract-conveyor for live route/state design review before compiling implementation contracts; implementation contracts only begin after the relevant Design Contract route cluster is approved.
Use $implementation-contract-conveyor to turn approved Design Contract clusters and implementation-readiness rows into one full-SDLC child contract under the active Implementation Contract parent.
Use $ticket-to-human-review to human-review and sign off an implementation contract before development/testing starts.
After contract signoff, run development/testing by directly composing $multi-agent-workflow, $layered-verification, worktree orchestration, review loops, and receipt-producing verification skills.
Use $ticket-day-operator to turn a board target and today's calendar into an hourly close plan with deploy-truth and shifted-schedule rules.
Use $calendar-dag-scheduler plus $linear-day-allocator when today's free windows need to become real Calendar blocks and due-today child tickets in Linear.
Use $parallel-lane-orchestrator plus $review-batch-orchestrator when multiple dependency-ready tickets should execute in parallel and converge into one grouped review wave.
Use $sequential-ticket-review-queue when you need the lowest-level review loop: one ticket worktree at a time, human validate it, sign off, move Linear to Done, then advance to the next ticket.
Use $beta-release-assist only for separate post-development release handoff after the human enters release work.
Use $day-state-updater when a blocker clears or a lane slips and the rest of the day needs to be reflowed honestly.
Use $feature-decision-ledger to compile feature ideas from Slack, meetings, and Linear into one beta thesis, non-goal, parking-lot, and kill-list surface.
